definitions.explanation: The act of putting a law, policy, plan, or system into effect.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{制度|せいど}を{来月|らいげつ}から{実施|じっし}する。
examples.english: The new system will be implemented starting next month.

examples.japanese: {アンケート|あんけーと}を{実施|じっし}した。
{法律|ほうりつ}の{実施|じっし}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to enforce a law.

notes:
{実施|じっし}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to implement" or "to carry out."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実施|じっし}する (to implement, to carry out)
- {実施|じっし}{日|び} (implementation date)
- {実施|じっし}{計画|けいかく} (implementation plan)
- {実施|じっし}{要領|ようりょう} (implementation guidelines)
- {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}に{実施|じっし}する (to implement fully)

COMPARISON:
- {実施|じっし}: implementation (of policies, plans, systems - formal)
- {実行|じっこう}: execution (of individual actions, programs)
